body:
https://cdn.discordapp.com/attachments/350491304175730688/382990213556731914/image.png
Today
https://cdn.discordapp.com/attachments/350491304175730688/381547721485451265/2017-11-18_15.50.40.png
Last Saturday
https://images-ext-2.discordapp.net/external/l1450-UexJgBe_mv-5LAs0WicfW-3Uh5Og0f5Vvx6yg/https/media...
Maybe about 2 weeks ago

I was under the impression that mods cannot kick players off of scrim servers for reasons unrelated to moderating. If they are using their moderator permissions to do otherwise, it is a form of abuse. Just because they have a mod rank does not allow them to do things that normal players cannot do (like force someone to sub out). In fact, this reason was one of the very reasons we demoted Ryan.
However, after talking to Distraction about this, it seemed to me that the policy changed. He claims that "well as long as it's harmless, we can allow it we just need to enforce quick removals of those punishments. If it tips to the point of abuse, we'll take care of it differently". First off, I'd like to just state that this rule is stupid. You're allowing a moderator to abuse their permissions, so long as they cover up after themselves when they are done.

At this point, I think Rilo has reached the "abuse" stage that Distraction defined.

https://media.discordapp.net/attachments/350491304175730688/376572201396207617/Screenshot_72.png?wid...
https://images-ext-2.discordapp.net/external/E_NnRQr9sUkNvIa5BL36wwRhfqrWDZDogiqHUuJhM5I/https/i.img...
Two weeks ago.

Now for this one, there was a user with a name that did not match their username in Rilo's channel. Steven joined with a name that did not match his IGN either (I don't care really about what Steven did, so don't take this the wrong way. It's how Rilo handled the situation that matters). Rilo promptly asked Steven to change his name, to which Steven argued that he would not change his name unless the user in Rilo's channel was also forced to change his name. Steven was kicked, and the user in Rilo's channel was not, nor did he change his name to something appropriate (I believe his name was changed to "suck me lunacy").

https://avicus.net/punishments/684175
today

[12:53 PM] surnames: and for saying Oh no its Rileo You're Banned For Sure"
This occurred after Rilo kicked surnames from his own scrim server. I don't really think it's valid

https://gyazo.com/55f2817a75a240371451ed596b25299b
2 weeks ago - scrim banter

This was during a scrim. I don't know the full details to this other than "a scrim was going on, everything was cool, then he pops in and dishes out tons of punishments like that". Also, are mutes still broken, cause this would have been a good place for them? (This last one could have a totally valid reason behind it, I don't actually know it so thread lightly).


I'll add more to this later, I've pretty much just summed up some complaints from community members over the last few weeks. Asking to see if I missed any at the time being.

Update: November 28th

So as promised, here's a bit more evidence. This was today on the official avicus tournament discord, so maybe you'd like to pass it on to an Official.
https://media.discordapp.net/attachments/350491304175730688/385272150564536320/image.png?width=266&h...
Not super appropriate conduct if you ask me. "die, thanks"
